spans.text: Weight acts straight down on the crate.

submission_text:
Weight acts straight down on the crate. The ramp pushes back with a normal force perpendicular to its surface. Static friction acts up the ramp, opposing the tendency to slide. Along the ramp, friction balances the component of weight, so the net force is zero. So the forces cancel.
